mapper.select: SELECT relation.id, relation.name, start_object.name AS startObjectName, end_object.name AS endObjectName FROM om_ai_relation relation INNER JOIN om_ai_object start_object ON start_object.id = relation.start_object_candidate_id INNER JOIN om_ai_object end_object ON end_object.id = relation.end_object_candidate_id WHERE relation.task_id = #{taskId} AND relation.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY relation.id LIMIT 500
